objects.name: mdl
objects.description: Native MDL named scene data: sceneData.<name> (ANARI_STRING) binds a name to attribute0..3 or color; Uniform eligibility is inferred from the effective attribute source: geometry/instance constants and selected instance-array elements are uniform, while overriding vertex/face-varying/primitive data is varying. Float/color lookups reuse interpolated attributes and return defaults for missing, nonfinite or incompatible uniform data. data_isvalid tests existence without reading values. Integer/matrix lookups remain unsupported. These dynamic names are documented rather than listed as literal query parameters.
